local function ForceStamina()
	if not State.InfiniteStamina then
		return
	end

	local MaxStamina, Stamina = GetStaminaValues()

	if not MaxStamina or not Stamina then
		return
	end

	pcall(function()
		if MaxStamina.Value ~= 999999 then
			MaxStamina.Value = 999999
		end

		if Stamina.Value ~= 999999 then
			Stamina.Value = 999999
		end
	end)
end

local function SetupStaminaWatch()
	DisconnectList(State.StaminaConnections)

	local MaxStamina, Stamina = GetStaminaValues()

	if not MaxStamina or not Stamina then
		return false
	end

	if State.OriginalMaxStamina == nil then
		State.OriginalMaxStamina = MaxStamina.Value
	end

	table.insert(
		State.StaminaConnections,
		MaxStamina:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
			if State.InfiniteStamina and MaxStamina.Value ~= 999999 then
				MaxStamina.Value = 999999
			end
		end)
	)

	table.insert(
		State.StaminaConnections,
		Stamina:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
			if State.InfiniteStamina and Stamina.Value ~= 999999 then
				Stamina.Value = 999999
			end
		end)
	)

	ForceStamina()

	return true
end

local function DisableStamina()
	DisconnectList(State.StaminaConnections)

	local MaxStamina, Stamina = GetStaminaValues()

	if MaxStamina and State.OriginalMaxStamina ~= nil then
		pcall(function()
			MaxStamina.Value = State.OriginalMaxStamina
		end)
	end

	if Stamina and MaxStamina then
		pcall(function()
			if Stamina.Value > MaxStamina.Value then
				Stamina.Value = MaxStamina.Value
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function IsGunConfig(Object)
	if not Object then
		return false
	end

	if Object.Name ~= "GunConfigs" then
		return false
	end

	return Object:FindFirstChild("Ammo") ~= nil
		or Object:FindFirstChild("Clip") ~= nil
end

local function IsOwnedByLocalPlayer(Object)
	if not Object then
		return false
	end

	local Backpack = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	local Character = Player.Character

	if Backpack and Object:IsDescendantOf(Backpack) then
		return true
	end

	if Character and Object:IsDescendantOf(Character) then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

local function FindMaxValues(Config)
	local MaxAmmo
	local MaxClip

	local AmmoConfigs = Config:FindFirstChild("AmmoConfigs")

	if AmmoConfigs then
		MaxAmmo = AmmoConfigs:FindFirstChild("MaxAmmo", true)
		MaxClip = AmmoConfigs:FindFirstChild("MaxClip", true)
	end

	return MaxAmmo, MaxClip
end

local function FillGun(Config)
	if not State.InfiniteAmmo then
		return
	end

	if not Config or not Config.Parent then
		return
	end

	if not IsOwnedByLocalPlayer(Config) then
		return
	end

	local Ammo = Config:FindFirstChild("Ammo")
	local Clip = Config:FindFirstChild("Clip")

	local MaxAmmo, MaxClip = FindMaxValues(Config)

	pcall(function()
		if MaxAmmo and MaxAmmo.Value ~= 999999 then
			MaxAmmo.Value = 999999
		end
	end)

	pcall(function()
		if MaxClip and MaxClip.Value ~= 999999 then
			MaxClip.Value = 999999
		end
	end)

	pcall(function()
		if Ammo and Ammo.Value ~= 999999 then
			Ammo.Value = 999999
		end
	end)

	pcall(function()
		if Clip and Clip.Value ~= 999999 then
			Clip.Value = 999999
		end
	end)
end

local function RemoveGun(Config)
	State.Guns[Config] = nil

	local Connections = State.GunConnections[Config]

	if Connections then
		DisconnectList(Connections)
		State.GunConnections[Config] = nil
	end
end

local function RegisterGun(Config)
	if not IsGunConfig(Config) then
		return
	end

	if State.Guns[Config] then
		if State.InfiniteAmmo then
			FillGun(Config)
		end

		return
	end

	State.Guns[Config] = true
	State.GunConnections[Config] = {}

	local Connections = State.GunConnections[Config]

	local Ammo = Config:FindFirstChild("Ammo")
	local Clip = Config:FindFirstChild("Clip")
	local MaxAmmo, MaxClip = FindMaxValues(Config)

	local function WatchValue(ValueObject)
		if not ValueObject then
			return
		end

		table.insert(
			Connections,
			ValueObject:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
				if State.InfiniteAmmo then
					FillGun(Config)
				end
			end)
		)
	end

	WatchValue(Ammo)
	WatchValue(Clip)
	WatchValue(MaxAmmo)
	WatchValue(MaxClip)

	table.insert(
		Connections,
		Config.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
			task.delay(0.15, function()
				if not State.Running then
					return
				end

				if not Config.Parent then
					RemoveGun(Config)
					return
				end

				if not IsOwnedByLocalPlayer(Config) then
					RemoveGun(Config)
				end
			end)
		end)
	)

	if State.InfiniteAmmo then
		FillGun(Config)
	end
end

local function RegisterTool(Tool)
	if not Tool then
		return
	end

	local Config = Tool:FindFirstChild("GunConfigs")

	if Config and IsGunConfig(Config) then
		RegisterGun(Config)
		return
	end

	for _, Object in ipairs(Tool:GetChildren()) do
		if IsGunConfig(Object) then
			RegisterGun(Object)
			return
		end
	end

	local DescendantConnection

	DescendantConnection = Tool.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(Object)
		if IsGunConfig(Object) then
			RegisterGun(Object)

			if DescendantConnection then
				DescendantConnection:Disconnect()
				DescendantConnection = nil
			end
		end
	end)

	task.delay(5, function()
		if DescendantConnection then
			DescendantConnection:Disconnect()
			DescendantConnection = nil
		end
	end)
end

local function ScanContainerOnce(Container)
	if not Container then
		return
	end

	for _, Object in ipairs(Container:GetChildren()) do
		RegisterTool(Object)
	end
end

local function ScanCurrentGuns()
	local Backpack = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	local Character = Player.Character

	ScanContainerOnce(Backpack)
	ScanContainerOnce(Character)
end

local function CountGuns()
	local Count = 0

	for Config in pairs(State.Guns) do
		if Config
			and Config.Parent
			and IsOwnedByLocalPlayer(Config)
		then
			Count += 1
		end
	end

	return Count
end

local function FillAllGuns()
	if not State.InfiniteAmmo then
		return
	end

	for Config in pairs(State.Guns) do
		if Config
			and Config.Parent
			and IsOwnedByLocalPlayer(Config)
		then
			FillGun(Config)
		end
	end
end

local function IsLoseClipRemote(Object)
	if typeof(Object) ~= "Instance" then
		return false
	end

	if Object.Name ~= "LoseClip" then
		return false
	end

	if not IsOwnedByLocalPlayer(Object) then
		return false
	end

	local Current = Object.Parent

	while Current do
		if Current.Name == "ServerMain" then
			return true
		end

		Current = Current.Parent
	end

	return false
end

if type(hookmetamethod) == "function"
	and type(getnamecallmethod) == "function"
	and type(newcclosure) == "function"
then

	local OldNamecall

	OldNamecall = hookmetamethod(
		game,
		"__namecall",
		newcclosure(function(Self, ...)
			local Method = getnamecallmethod()

			if State.InfiniteAmmo
				and (
					Method == "FireServer"
					or Method == "InvokeServer"
				)
				and IsLoseClipRemote(Self)
			then
				return nil
			end

			return OldNamecall(Self, ...)
		end)
	)
end

local WatchedContainers = {}

local function WatchContainer(Container)
	if not Container then
		return
	end

	if WatchedContainers[Container] then
		return
	end

	WatchedContainers[Container] = true

	ScanContainerOnce(Container)

	local AddedConnection = Container.ChildAdded:Connect(function(Object)
		task.defer(function()
			RegisterTool(Object)
		end)
	end)

	local RemovedConnection = Container.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(Object)
		task.delay(0.15, function()
			if Object.Parent then
				return
			end

			for Config in pairs(State.Guns) do
				if Config
					and (
						Config == Object
						or Config:IsDescendantOf(Object)
					)
				then
					RemoveGun(Config)
				end
			end
		end)
	end)

	table.insert(State.Connections, AddedConnection)
	table.insert(State.Connections, RemovedConnection)
end

local function SetupPlayerWatchers()
	local Backpack = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")

	if Backpack then
		WatchContainer(Backpack)
	end

	if Player.Character then
		WatchContainer(Player.Character)
	end

	table.insert(
		State.Connections,
		Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(Character)
			task.wait(0.15)

			WatchContainer(Character)

			if State.InfiniteStamina then
				SetupStaminaWatch()
			end

			if State.InfiniteAmmo then
				ScanCurrentGuns()
				FillAllGuns()
			end
		end)
	)

	table.insert(
		State.Connections,
		Player.ChildAdded:Connect(function(Object)
			if Object:IsA("Backpack") then
				task.defer(function()
					WatchContainer(Object)

					if State.InfiniteAmmo then
						ScanCurrentGuns()
						FillAllGuns()
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
	)
end

    local success, RE = pcall(function()

    local nameRemote = RE:FindFirstChild("1RPNam1eTex1t")
    local colorRemote = RE:FindFirstChild("1RPNam1eColo1r")
    return nameRemote, colorRemote
end

gui.Name = "QuickFlickGui"

local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Name = "FlickButton"
button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 42)
button.Position = UDim2.new(1, -120, 0.5, -80)
button.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
button.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
button.BorderSizePixel = 0
button.Text = "FLICK"
button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
button.TextSize = 15
button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
button.AutoButtonColor = true
button.Active = true
button.Selectable = false
button.ZIndex = 10
button.Parent = gui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
corner.Parent = button

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Thickness = 1
stroke.Transparency = 0.5
stroke.Parent = button

local function flickRight()
	if flicking then
		return
	end

	camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

	if not camera then
		return
	end

	flicking = true

	local originalCFrame = camera.CFrame

	local flickCFrame =
		originalCFrame *
		CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(-FLICK_ANGLE), 0)

	camera.CFrame = flickCFrame

	task.wait(FLICK_TIME)

	camera.CFrame = originalCFrame

	RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()

	camera.CFrame = originalCFrame

	flicking = false
end

button.Activated:Connect(function()
	flickRight()
end)

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then
		return
	end

	if input.KeyCode == FLICK_KEY then
		flickRight()
	end
end)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	task.wait(0.5)
	camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	flicking = false
end)
